assistant_invocations_one_target.name: assistant_invocations_one_target
assistant_invocations_one_target.value:
("assistant_invocations"."channel_id" is not null and "assistant_invocations"."trigger_message_id" is not null and "assistant_invocations"."post_id" is null and "assistant_invocations"."trigger_reply_id" is null)
        or ("assistant_invocations"."post_id" is not null and "assistant_invocations"."trigger_reply_id" is not null and "assistant_invocations"."channel_id" is null and "assistant_invocations"."trigger_message_id" is null)

posts_test_fields_require_a_tester_forma.name: posts_test_fields_require_a_tester_format
posts_test_fields_require_a_tester_forma.value: coalesce("posts"."format" = 'a_tester', false) or ("posts"."test_url" is null and "posts"."test_ask" is null)

work_media_source.name: work_media_source
work_media_source.value: ("work_media"."kind" = 'youtube') = ("work_media"."youtube_id" is not null and "work_media"."storage_key" is null)

opportunities_kind_fields.name: opportunities_kind_fields
opportunities_kind_fields.value:
("opportunities"."kind" = 'mission' and "opportunities"."budget_min_fcfa" is not null and "opportunities"."budget_max_fcfa" is not null
          and "opportunities"."budget_min_fcfa" <= "opportunities"."budget_max_fcfa" and "opportunities"."deadline" is not null
          and "opportunities"."contract_type" is null and "opportunities"."start_date" is null and "opportunities"."compensation_fcfa" is null)
        or ("opportunities"."kind" in ('job', 'internship') and "opportunities"."contract_type" is not null and "opportunities"."start_date" is not null
          and "opportunities"."budget_min_fcfa" is null and "opportunities"."budget_max_fcfa" is null)
